lines.en: Hooves crunch on loose stone.
My fleece is hard as rock.
Step by step, heavily.
I graze the hillside slowly.

lines.zh: 灰扑扑的一团，在石堆里。
lines.en: A gray lump among the rocks.
My steps kick up pebbles.
Short legs, steady footing.

lines.zh: 这地方石头多，正合我意。
lines.en: Plenty of stone here — suits me.
I shift over for fresher grass.
My fleece is heavy; hurrying winds me.
Around a boulder and I'm gone.
Head down walking, head up now and then.
The grass in cracks tastes sweetest.
I rub against the rock face.
A hoof slips on stone.
Dust on gray wool makes it grayer.
Standing still, I look like stone.
I chew the grass fine before swallowing.
Little pebbles lodge in my fleece.
Wind comes over the hill.
I shake my head at the flies.
Sun on gray wool feels warm.
My legs tire; I kneel a while.
A distant bleat — I ignore it.
I stare at a stone on the ground.
This fleece grows heavier each year.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，听到自己的呼吸。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear my own breathing.
I bury my face in the grass.
Cool among the stones.
Stillness keeps me unnoticed.
A bug buzzes by my ear.
I give a soft snort.

lines.zh: 你踩得石头直响，我早听见了。
lines.en: Your boots crunch; I heard you coming.

lines.zh: 我抬起眼，从灰毛缝里看你。
lines.en: I lift my eyes and look at you through my grey wool.

lines.zh: 灰毛遮着眼睛，我侧过脸。
lines.en: Gray wool covers my eyes; I turn my head.
Come to shear me?

lines.zh: 我退了一步，蹄子磕到石。
lines.en: I step back; a hoof knocks stone.
Are those shears in your hand?
Don't touch; the wool is rough.

lines.zh: 我们互相对看，谁也不动。
lines.en: We stare; neither moves.

lines.zh: 你比我高半个身子，我照样抬眼。
lines.en: You stand half a body taller, and I still look up.
This hillside is mine.
You're blocking my grass.
I tilt my head as you walk off.
Ow! I jump.
Thick wool doesn't stop that.

lines.zh: 我拖着后腿，蹭到岩壁边上。
lines.en: I drag my hind leg over to the rock wall.
My legs give and I kneel.
My bleat comes out short and shrill.
This will heal slowly.

lines.zh: 我甩着头，灰毛上的土簌簌掉。
lines.en: I shake my head and dirt falls from my grey wool.
Not at my forelegs.
Blood seeps into gray wool, unseen.
I shuffle a few steps away.
Is that grass in your hand?
Smells all right; I'll come look.
I edge over carefully.
Not so high; I can't reach.
Wave the grass and I follow.
I eat slowly; don't rush.
Step back so I dare eat.
This one I can chew.

lines.zh: 石头缝里的不够，这个好。
lines.en: Cracks give little; this is better.
I eat and watch you at once.
Another handful; I'm not full.
Just set the grass down.
The green smell beats the stone smell.

lines.zh: 我先闻了闻，才慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I sniff it first, then shuffle over.
My mouth's full; no room.
Tenderer than hillside grass.

lines.zh: 撞我？我这身毛底下全是硬肉。
lines.en: Bump me? Under this wool I'm solid.
You brushed my fleece.
I move slowly — sorry.
Let's both step back.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子擦过你的靴子，滑开了。
lines.en: My hoof skids off your boot.
I turn sideways to let you pass.
Bumping my fleece doesn't hurt.
How did you run into me?
Which is harder, the stone or me?

lines.zh: 我一肩膀抵过去，纹丝不动。
lines.en: I brace my shoulder into you and do not budge.
That one across the hill has good wool.
I walk over slowly, not rashly.

lines.zh: 两头羊挨着啃同一丛草。
lines.en: Two sheep nibbling the same clump.
Her fleece is softer than mine.
Two gray sheep squeezed in a rock gap.
I nudge her with my head.

lines.zh: 这坡上安静，适合养小羊。
lines.en: Quiet slope — good for lambs.
I bleat softly; she answers.
In spring the stones warm too.
Walking together, neither hurries.

lines.zh: 地上有块嫩草，我咬起来。
lines.en: A tuft of grass — I pull it up.

lines.zh: 我低头去叼，下巴磕在石上。
lines.en: I dip my mouth to grab it and clunk my chin on stone.
Would this hurt my teeth?
I lower my head; wool blocks my eyes.
A small bite, chewed slowly.
I waste nothing fallen.
Picked it up, dropped it again.
Clumsy mouth; picking up is hard work.
This will keep me chewing a while.
I carry it off a couple of steps.
A shadow shifts behind the stones.
I raise my head, ears twitching.
Not a sheep's scent.
My horns aim at the back of your knee.
Under the gray wool, my legs tense.
What are you holding? I can't see.
I back toward the rock.

lines.zh: 身后碎石一响，我的角转过去。
lines.en: Gravel crunches behind me and my horns swing round.
I don't like that sound.
I've fixed where you're standing.
Still standing there?
Head low, my horns toward you.
Closer and I'll butt.
Rock behind me; no retreat.
Through the wool, I never stop watching.

lines.zh: 我压低脑袋，角尖对着你胸口。
lines.en: I drop my head and point both horn tips at your chest.
My snorting grows rough — a warning.
One step from you, one from me.
This distance is tolerable.
Then let's both just wait.
I butt with my head!
Hands off my fleece!
Blunt horns, but plenty of force.
Hooves kick too.
One butt, then back to the rocks.
Your hands must be numb now.
I bleat and charge.
On stone I keep my footing.
Don't think sheep are easy.

lines.zh: 顶完这一下，我喘得厉害。
lines.en: After that butt I'm gasping.
I step out from behind the rocks.
Grass seeds cling to my gray wool.
So many stones here.
First, find solid footing.
Hooves land and steady.
Mountain wind stirs my fleece.
Any grass? I'm hungry.

lines.zh: 我一脚一脚踩进这块坡地。
lines.en: I plant each hoof into this slope.
Grit patters off my gray wool.

lines.zh: 一块会动的石头出现了。
lines.en: A moving stone has appeared.
My wool singes; the smell is sharp.
I roll down the slope, dazed.
Water soaks my fleece and I sink.
Blast scatters stone; I drop low.

lines.zh: 箭卡在厚毛里，够不着皮肉。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my thick wool, short of flesh.

lines.zh: 那股力量压得我四蹄发软。
lines.en: That force softens all four of my legs.
Too hungry to chew even grass.
Lightning strikes; I lock up.

lines.zh: 脚下没石头，我直往下掉。
lines.en: No stone below; I keep falling.
